description: This file contains functions for preparing, clearing, and retrieving repository settings in a Git-like version control system, including configuration parsing and setting defaults.

methods.name: repo_cfg_bool
methods.description: Sets a boolean configuration value for a repository, defaulting if the config is present.

methods.name: repo_cfg_int
methods.description: Sets an integer configuration value for a repository, defaulting if the config is present.

methods.name: repo_cfg_ulong
methods.description: Sets an unsigned long configuration value for a repository, defaulting if the config is present.

methods.name: prepare_repo_settings
methods.description: Initializes and applies configuration settings to a repository object based on config values.

methods.name: repo_settings_clear
methods.description: Resets the repository settings to default/empty values.

methods.name: repo_settings_get_big_file_threshold
methods.description: Returns the threshold for big files in the repository, loading default if unset.

methods.name: repo_settings_set_big_file_threshold
methods.description: Sets the big file threshold for the repository.

methods.name: repo_settings_get_log_all_ref_updates
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration for logging all reference updates.

methods.name: repo_settings_get_warn_ambiguous_refs
methods.description: Returns whether ambiguous refs warning is enabled.

methods.name: repo_settings_get_hooks_path
methods.description: Returns the hooks path for the repository, loading from config if not set.

methods.name: repo_settings_get_shared_repository
methods.description: Returns the shared repository setting, loading from config if not initialized.

methods.name: repo_settings_reset_shared_repository
methods.description: Resets the shared repository setting to uninitialized state.
